name: Camille
notes: Opens with R at t=0 (its dash then opens the zone after 0.5 s) and Q as soon as its own readiness allows, effectively also at t=0.

Precision Protocol (Q) arms the next basic attack; when it lands, its bonus physical damage is dealt, then the recast is always delayed until exactly 1.5 s after that landing (never sooner) to get the doubled bonus damage and the true-damage conversion, matching the highest-damage line of play; Q's real cooldown only starts once the second (recast) empowered attack lands.

The true-damage conversion percentage is applied only to Precision Protocol's own bonus-damage instance (the wiki's 'Increased Mixed Damage' / total of that instance), not to the attack's separate base auto-attack damage, since the engine deals the base attack instance independently of the driver and there is no hook to split it.

Neither empowered attack's Precision Protocol bonus can critically strike (modeled with crit_mod=false); the game engine's own base auto-attack damage on that same swing is handled outside the driver and may still average in a crit, an approximation of the 'this attack cannot crit' rule.
The true-damage percentage is capped at 100% for levels 17-18 as the wiki states, rather than the numbers sheet's literal uncapped 104%/108% tail.

Tactical Sweep (W) is cast on cooldown; its 1.1 s sweep animation blocks basic attacks (but not other ability casts) and its damage - the base cone hit plus the outer-cone additional hit, assumed to land in the outer half for maximum damage - lands when the animation ends.

Tactical Sweep's outer-cone additional damage uses only the flat percent-of-target-maximum-health scaling from the numbers sheet; the wiki's stated +2.5% per 100 bonus AD on top of it is flagged in the numbers sheet as a tooltip-only constant with no backing calculation, so it is not applied.

Hookshot/Wall Dive (E) is cast on cooldown, assuming terrain is always in range to hook onto; its dash and wall-attach time are not modeled beyond the usual 0.25 s cast lockout, so its damage and attack-speed buff land immediately on cast.

The Hextech Ultimatum (R) is cast once at the opening: after its 0.5 s dash, the zone opens and Camille's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage against the target for the zone's full duration (the dummy can never leave it); its cooldown (90-140 s) is far longer than the fight, so it is never recast.
Adaptive Defenses (the passive shield) is purely defensive and deals no damage, so it is not modeled.
Mana costs are not modeled: Camille's mana pool at level 16 comfortably covers every cast used in a 15 s fight given Q/W/E/R's costs.

assumed.why: Hookshot/Wall Dive requires terrain to hook onto; assumed available every cast so its damage can be used each cooldown against the stationary dummy, per the dossier's rotation proposal.
levels 17-18 are capped at 100% per the wiki text rather than the numbers sheet's uncapped 104%/108% tail values.
